summary: IFF entered a Transaction Agreement to sell its Food Ingredients business to CVC Capital Partners affiliates for ~$4.3B. IFF will receive ~$3.8B cash net of adjustments plus a ~$200M minority equity interest (~9.9%). The deal is subject to HSR and non-U.S. regulatory approvals, no material adverse change, and customary closing conditions. Termination date is May 28, 2027. Watch for regulatory clearances and potential competing bids; risk-arb spread will hinge on antitrust timeline.
